headline: Project Leader | Community Builder
summary: Project leader with experience managing teams, executing large-scale events, and securing partnerships across NGOs and organizations. Led initiatives with 400+ participants and raised $9,000+ in funding. Focused on delivering structured, high-impact projects.

points: Managed planning and execution of 2 hackathons with 200+ participants
Coordinated cross-functional teams across 4 departments to deliver events on time
Secured partnerships with 2 government organizations and 5 NGOs
Raised over $9,000 in funding to support program execution and growth
Lead and manage a team of 20+ members across 4 departments
Secured partnerships with 1 government organization and 3 NGOs to support event operations
Raised $400+ in funding for youth volunteering initiatives
Directed end-to-end execution of 2 large-scale conferences with 250+ participants
Oversaw planning, delegation, and delivery to ensure smooth event operations and participant experience
Coordinate online webinars featuring guest speakers and industry professionals
Moderate live sessions, ensuring smooth interaction between speakers and audience
Design structured discussion flows and research-backed questions to drive engagement
